marta: quick check — after we shaded the SDK into the service jar, some customers hit 401s intermittently when using token auth. The same token works from curl. Anyone seen an auth/OkHttp + shading oddness?

samir: hm, 401s only after shading sounds like classloader or header mangling. Are you using an interceptor to add Authorization header or the OkHttp authenticator?

marta: interceptor. basic code:
```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .addInterceptor { chain ->
    val req = chain.request().newBuilder()
      .header("Authorization", "Bearer $TOKEN")
      .build()
    chain.proceed(req)
  }
  .build()
```
We also relocated com.fasterxml.* to com.ourorg._shadow.com.fasterxml in the fat jar.

kai: two quick possibilities: (1) shading broke Jackson deserialization used in the token refresher (different package path at runtime), so a refresh step is failing silently; (2) another lib (like a proxy) stripping or folding headers when chunked streaming is present.

jen: do you see the header in a tcp dump? can you log outgoing request headers in the interceptor before proceed()?

marta: good idea. I added logging and the header is present most times, but in ~15% of requests it’s missing. The missing cases line up with long-polling/streaming requests (we use NDJSON streaming for events).

samir: ah — if you’re reusing the same Request.Builder across streaming boundaries that could be mutated. Also shading sometimes relocates okhttp3.internal.* which can change connection pooling behavior. Are you using the shadow plugin relocate for okhttp packages?

marta: we relocated only jackson and gson packages. okhttp left alone. But we do use the SDK's helper that clones requests:
```kotlin
fun cloneWithAuth(req: Request, token: String): Request =
  req.newBuilder().header("Authorization", "Bearer $token").build()
```
I assumed newBuilder is safe.

kai: newBuilder() is safe but if the original request had a streaming body or a one-shot request body, cloning may cause the body to be consumed. OkHttp marks some RequestBody types as one-shot. When body can't be re-sent, OkHttp may rebuild headers differently for retries/follow-ups. That could explain intermittent missing header on a follow-up or retry.

jen: also check if you have an Authenticator (for 401) that calls client.newCall(syncTokenRefreshRequest).execute() synchronously — that can deadlock if using the same dispatcher. Use a separate OkHttp client for token refresh or run refresh on a different dispatcher.

marta: we do use the same client for refresh. :grimacing: will try separate client for refresh. Any quick shading tips so Jackson/Gson relocation doesn't break reflective calls?

samir: relocate, yes, but also keep meta classes / service loader entries consistent. If you relocate com.fasterxml, make sure any jackson-databind module lookup that uses ServiceLoader still finds them — sometimes you need to include a relocated META-INF/services entry. Also check kotlin-reflect vs jackson-kotlin-module package names.

kai: workaround if you don't want to fiddle with services: initialize ObjectMapper programmatically with the KotlinModule and any modules you need instead of relying on automatic discovery. Eg:
```kotlin
val mapper = ObjectMapper().registerModule(KotlinModule()).registerModule(JavaTimeModule())
```
That avoids ServiceLoader surprises after shading.

marta: thanks. Last oddity — NDJSON streaming responses from our SDK client sometimes get aggregated (no chunk events) when proxied through the enterprise gateway. Any fixes?

jen: proxy config often buffers until content-length or connection close. Ensure server sends `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and that the gateway is configured to forward chunked responses. For OkHttp client, set readTimeout(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) for long-lived streams and disable connection pooling eviction? Also verify `addNetworkInterceptor` vs `addInterceptor` since network interceptors see raw bytes.

samir: and if you rely on EventSource or SSE libs, prefer `addNetworkInterceptor` to inspect streaming bytes so nothing in upper-level interceptors touches the body prematurely.

devex-bot: CI build #2345 for service-shadow-jackson finished — shadow relocation updated to include META-INF/services entries. https://ci.internal/2345 :white_check_mark:

marta: perfect — I'll try: (1) separate client for token refresh, (2) explicit ObjectMapper modules, (3) log headers & tcpdump for missing Authorization, (4) test gateway chunked forwarding. Will report back. Thanks all :pray:
